notes: Only marginal energy costs belong in source selection; fixed daily/monthly charges are excluded.
During saldering periods, exported PV is conservatively valued at the applicable import tariff. This avoids treating PV as free while kWh can still offset imported electricity.
The current-contract feed-in figure of -0.15000 EUR/kWh is retained as metadata only because its exact marginal interaction with saldering is not yet proven; it is not used by the advisor.
From 2027-01-01 ENGIE export opportunity value is feed-in remuneration minus feed-in cost: 0.12205 - 0.11666 = 0.00539 EUR/kWh.
